initial.subject: Quick note after seeing your work
initial.body:
Hi {firstName},

{emailOpening}

Quick question: is anything in your online flow currently slowing you down (website, automations, client funnel)?

I help spiritual entrepreneurs streamline their systems so they attract more ideal clients with less effort.

If you want, I can take a quick look and tell you exactly where the bottleneck is.

Would that be useful?

Cheers,
Koen

auto_followup_1.subject: RE: {originalSubject}
auto_followup_1.body:
Hi {firstName},

Just wanted to quickly follow up in case my last message got buried.

Still happy to take a quick look at your online flow and point out anything that might be quietly costing you clients or time.

No pressure at all, just let me know.

Cheers,
Koen
auto_followup_1.description: Automatic follow-up 3 days after initial contact

auto_followup_2.subject: Quick check-in
auto_followup_2.body:
Hi {firstName},

I know inboxes get busy, so I'll keep this short.

If optimizing your website or client flow isn't a priority right now, no worries at all.
If it is, I'm happy to share 1–2 concrete observations — no pitch attached.

If this isn't relevant, feel free to ignore this... I won't keep following up.

Best,
Koen
auto_followup_2.description: Follow-up #2 (5-7 days after follow-up #1, reduces friction)

auto_followup_3.subject: Closing the loop
auto_followup_3.body:
Hi {firstName},

I'll close the loop after this.

If streamlining your online flow would be useful at some point, feel free to reply with "later" or "curious" and I'll take it from there.

If this isn't relevant, feel free to ignore this... I won't keep following up.

Warm regards,
Koen
auto_followup_3.description: Final follow-up (7-10 days after follow-up #2, polite close-out)

follow_up_1.subject: Made your site live
follow_up_1.body:
{firstName}, I know you've got a million things going on. Finding time for this is tough.

TBH, I was thinking about you over the weekend and got a little carried away. I was so convinced your work could look incredible that I went ahead and made your site live.

Here it is: {mockupUrl}

Let me know what you think.

Koen

follow_up_2.body:
{firstName},
